content.short: Totemancer is a PvP strategy game on web and Telegram where players fight for land and collect bonus-granting Totems.
content.description: Totemancer is a tactical PvP strategy game playable in a browser or through Telegram. Players place totems, control parts of the map, outplay real opponents, and collect unique Totems that unlock special bonuses during land battles. Battle for land, outsmart real opponents, and collect unique Totems that unlock special gameplay bonuses in a skill-driven tactical experience. Play on Web Play on Telegram News & Updates Totems Players Borders Help Guides Strategy Brain Chess Go FAQ How to play?.
